name: LaLiga
advancement_rules: Double round-robin. Three points for a win, one for a draw. Ties are broken by goal difference, then goals scored. The first-placed club is champion
column11: the bottom three are relegated to Segunda División.

name: Copa del Rey
advancement_rules: Single-elimination from the round of 32. Lower-division clubs host. Ties go to extra time and penalties. Semi-finals are played over two legs. The final is at a neutral venue. A sixth substitution is allowed in extra time.

name: Coppa Italia
advancement_rules: Single-elimination from the round of 32. Ties go to extra time and penalties. Semi-finals are played over two legs. The final is played at Stadio Olimpico. A sixth substitution is allowed in extra time.

name: Puchar Polski
advancement_rules: Single-elimination from the round of 32 in one-off matches. Ties go to extra time and penalties. The final is played at PGE Narodowy. A sixth substitution is allowed in extra time.
